03aa1dba86.why: Both products and the stored sum are live, and SSSE3 has no fused operation that eliminates the copy or either multiplication.

afa8101923.why: SSE2 requires the conditional negations and unpacking steps, while the separate denoised values and accumulated values must all be preserved.

694d91af8d.why: The four independent SAD calculations and their live partial sums require the existing loads and arithmetic under SSE2.

fb79e8a568.why: The low and high byte expansions, squared sums, and intermediate vector results are all needed, with no shorter SSE2 fused operation.

bb39a2f06f.why: Each of the five instructions produces a distinct required vector result, including the zeroed upper YMM halves.

9cdbaee99d.why: SSE2 needs separate byte expansion and subtraction instructions, and the expanded subtrahends must also remain in xmm2 and xmm3.

b520db780a.why: Both vectors already use memory-source additions, and the index update and final comparison are separately required.

34c9a93ea2.why: Both loaded vectors are needed, and folding a QWORD load into an SSE2 packed-byte addition would read beyond the allowed memory.

91c93f7bc7.why: The byte load, memory-source addition, store, and index increment each perform a required operation.

35db6636c7.why: The arbitrary unpack operand and coefficients require the separate SSE2 expansions and products, whose intermediate results are also live.

850e2ca9da.why: The arbitrary coefficients require the existing SSE2 filter arithmetic, and averaging needs the separate eight-byte destination load.

97056bc051.why: The sliding-window register values and expanded load must all survive, while SSE2 requires separate rounding, shifting, and packing operations.

253f509102.why: The sliding-window outputs, SSE2 filter arithmetic, and loaded destination vector are all required for the preserved results.

ae5aaede55.why: The three saturated pair products and sliding-window outputs require their current operands and copies, with rounding already handled by pmulhrsw.

c240220c96.why: Three arbitrary shuffle masks require independent copies of the loaded bytes, and the resulting products, rounding, and packing are all needed.

af505780ec.why: The saturated filter products, sliding-window outputs, and eight-byte destination load leave no removable instruction under SSSE3.

a9fca24fc9.why: The three arbitrary shuffles and saturated products are required, and the final average cannot fold its eight-byte load into a 128-bit memory operand.

0b23f1dfd6.rewrite:
movdqa xmm1,XMMWORD PTR [CONST_1]
pxor xmm0,xmm0
imul rax,r9,0xfffffffffffffff8
sub rdi,rax
sub rsi,rax
sub rdx,rax
movd xmm2,ecx
movd xmm3,r8d
pshuflw xmm2,xmm2,0x0
punpcklqdq xmm2,xmm2
pshuflw xmm3,xmm3,0x0
punpcklqdq xmm3,xmm3
0b23f1dfd6.why: Compute the final negative eightfold offset directly with imul and subtract it from each pointer. This preserves all register values modulo 64 bits, and no flags need to match.

pxor xmm0,xmm0

sub rdi,rax

sub rdx,rax
movd xmm2,ecx
movd xmm3,r8d

pshuflw xmm3,xmm3,0x0
punpcklqdq xmm3,xmm3
a4d3e9d7c4.why: Compute the final negative sixteenfold offset directly with imul and subtract it from each pointer. This preserves all register values modulo 64 bits, and no flags need to match.

338ffc0d5b.why: The arbitrary unpack operand and multipliers prevent simpler widening arithmetic, and all four product paths have required final vector results.
